# What the chart says about Mother Teresa

## In plain words
This page is the whole reading in ordinary words. Everything below it is the same thing said in the traditional way, with the reasons and the book references. Nothing here is new — if this page and a chapter below disagree, the chapter is right.

## About you
In temperament, the method describes someone who is quick-minded and talkative, at home with words, numbers and dealing. That is a description of tendencies, not a verdict on your character.

## Right now
Right now the method reads an ordinary stretch. These are the matters it calls live — which parts of life the old method considers active, not a claim that anything in particular is coming:

## Unusual for this chart
Most of this reading would fit most people. The few places where it does not — where it says something that only a small minority of charts say — are these: it is unusually positive about spending, time away from home, and inner life, your father and living far from where you were born. If you want to test whether any of this is worth anything, test it there.

## Matters that read well
- your health and energy
- courage, and brothers and sisters
- home, property and your mother
- children and learning
- marriage and partnerships
- big changes and difficult passages
- luck, higher study and your father
- work and standing
- income, gains and friends
- spending, time away from home, and inner life

## Matters that read hard
- illness, debts and rivals

## Live right now
- money and family life
- big changes and difficult passages
- income, gains and friends
